subject: Discovery recap & PoC plan \u0014 Nimbus Retail
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie@nimbusretail.com>, Marco Ramos <marco.r@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & PoC plan  Nimbus Retail

Hi Sophie / Marco 

Thanks again for a great conversation today. Wanted to capture the key takeaways and propose a concrete PoC plan so we can align on scope and owners. Please review and let me know if I missed anything.

Summary of pain points
- High latency on AI-powered search and rerank during peak traffic (esp. flash sales) causing page-timeouts and lower conversions.
- Fragmented ML infra: some models on managed endpoints, others self-hosted; ops overhead for tuning and cost control.
- Need for stronger observability on per-route inference cost and latency distributions for SLO-driven decisions.

Current stack
- Frontend: React + Next.js
- Search backend: Elasticsearch (hosted) + Python Flask microservices calling current LL model endpoints (proprietary)
- Authentication: Okta SSO; data in GCP (BigQuery for events)

Success criteria for PoC
- Reduce 95th percentile inference latency by >= 30% for product search rerank flows at target QPS (example: 200 qps sustained, 500 qps burst)
- Demonstrate predictable per-token cost reduction vs current provider (>= 20%) in production-like load test
- Validate SDK integration for Node (server-side) and Python (worker) with minimal code changes

Proposed PoC scope & timeline
1) Week 0 (this week): Kickoff + access checklist completed (Okta service account + sample traffic slice)
2) Week 1: Sandbox integration  Node SDK server-side integration + Python worker adapter; end-to-end request path validated using replayed traffic
3) Week 2: Performance testing at target QPS; latency and cost measurement; implement prefix caching for search queries
4) Week 3: Evaluation & success review; next steps for Dedicated or Private deployment if criteria met

Owners
- Redwood: Alex (integration, performance testing), Marissa (commercial cadence, enablement)
- Nimbus: Sophie (product owner), Marco (platform/infra lead)

Attachments: PoC plan spreadsheet and integration checklist attached. Also linking a short integration guide here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c4d-redwood-nimbus-poc

Next steps (please confirm):
- Nimbus to grant Okta service account + example replay traffic by Fri 24 Jul
- Align on exact QPS targets and sample dataset by Mon 26 Jul
- Quick sync (30m) to finalize PoC runbook  propose Mon 27 Jul 10:00 AM PT (I'll send calendar invite once you confirm)

Thanks!

 Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

From: Sophie Grant <sophie@nimbusretail.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Ramos <marco.r@nimbusretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & PoC plan  Nimbus Retail

Thanks Alex  this looks great and matches what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications: 

1) QPS target: Our initial target for the rerank flow is 250 qps sustained with 600 qps 1-minute bursts during peak windows. Happy to tighten those numbers if you have a preferred benchmarking approach.
2) Data access: We can provide a replay of last month's anonymized search traffic and a set of product metadata (CSV). We'll need to coordinate with Marco to create the Okta service account.

We can do the quick sync on Mon 27 Jul, 10:00 AM PT  confirmed on my side.

Also, can you call out the Node SDK flow for server-side streaming? Our frontend team is particularly interested in streaming token responses for partial rankings.

Best,
Sophie
Head of Product, Nimbus Retail
Sophie Grant | sophie@nimbusretail.com

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Marco Ramos <marco.r@nimbusretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & PoC plan  Nimbus Retail

Perfect  thanks Sophie. Quick notes on your questions: 

- Node SDK streaming: our Node SDK supports server-side streaming responses over HTTP/2 and WebSocket. For your rerank flow, we recommend using HTTP/2 streaming from the worker that builds candidate lists so you can start rendering partial ranks immediately. We'll include a small example in the integration checklist (attached).

- Benchmarking approach: we'll run both replay-based and synthetic spike tests. For fairness, we'll match your production payload sizes and use the same concurrency profile in the replay. We'll share the test harness results in the Drive link.

I'll send the calendar invite for Mon 27 Jul 10:00 AM PT and attach the PoC plan + integration checklist in this thread. Looking forward to the run.

 Alex
